credits.title: TWICE Showcase Live Tour 2018 "Candy Pop"
credits.overview: TWICE Showcase Live Tour 2018 "Candy Pop" is the first showcase tour by TWICE. Held in support of their second Japanese single "Candy Pop", the group visited six Japanese cities from January 19 to February 1, 2018.

credits.title: TWICE TOUR [TWICELAND : THE OPENING ENCORE]
credits.overview: "TWICELAND : THE OPENING ENCORE" was the grand finale of TWICE's first official concert tour. It served as the concluding chapter of their highly successful "TWICELAND: The Opening" tour.

credits.title: TWICE TOUR [TWICELAND : THE OPENING]
credits.overview: "TWICELAND: THE OPENING" was the debut solo concert tour by the South Korean girl group TWICE. Kicking off in February 2017, the tour supported their early hit releases and included multiple stops across Asia, culminating in a highly anticipated encore show in Seoul.

credits.title: Twice Debut Showcase "Touchdown In Japan"
credits.overview: Twice Debut Showcase "Touchdown In Japan" is Twice's first debut showcase concert in Japan. It took place in Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium in Japan and 2 shows had took place in 1 day.

credits.title: TWICE Fan Meeting [ONCE BEGINS]
credits.overview: "Once Begins" is TWICE's second anniversary fan meeting. JYPE released an introduction video of the fan meet on September 17, 2017. They also released individual photos of members wearing their outfits from "Like Ooh-Ahh" music video. The fan meet took place at Kyunghee University on October 14 and 15, 2017.

credits.title: TWICE Super Event
credits.overview: Along with the successful release of Twicecoaster: Lane 1, Twice held a Super Event in Seoul on January 22, 2017. The girls spent an amazing night with over 2,000 fans for the fan meeting, during which they played funny games and performed hit songs such as "Cheer Up" and "TT."
